name: Click parent reveals subcategories

actions.comment: Was a bare `goto http://localhost:3086/rss-reader`. The page is behind the token + setup gates now, so unauthenticated it landed on /login. Also switched off the hardcoded host so the run honours e2e.config.json's baseUrl.

expect: Sidebar shows Entertainment expanded with sub-folders Books, Movies, Music, TV, Gaming visible underneath, indented with a left guide line
The sub-category names are rendered without the 'Entertainment/' prefix
